title: Swamp Stasis Porch
description: A weathered green wooden porch with ornate railing overlooks a misty Louisiana bayou at sunset. A massive ancient oak draped in Spanish moss stands in the water, its branch holding a white heron, a bottle of liquor, and a glass, while a hammock and scattered Mardi Gras beads adorn the porch of the building labeled 'STASIS'.
prompt: A hauntingly beautiful Louisiana bayou scene at twilight with a vibrant orange and purple sunset sky. In the foreground, a weathered green wooden porch labeled STASIS features an ornate railing, a hanging hammock with purple Mardi Gras beads, and scattered beads on the deck. A massive ancient cypress tree covered in Spanish moss rises from the still water, its thick branch holding a white heron, a bottle of liquor and a glass. In the background, an old abandoned white plantation house stands across the misty swamp filled with cypress knees and lily pads.
